notes.title: VR Zen Garden 1.2 and Beyond (Roadmap)
notes.content:
[b]1.2 Interactions Update[/b]
[b]And 50% off Sale![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/66a25fb10cab3dc5ebfed1e67ecf371aeb3af60e.jpg[/img]
This update introduces Interactables and Stations. A drawing station you can spawn anywhere to draw, write affirmations, things you are thankful for, or words to meditate on. You can also delete the pad and have the text floating in space. Other stations includes a table and a variety of rocks you can practice stacking, arrange in the sand garden, or anywhere you wish. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/9ff92e062932f663fdb83c64fb6b32f51af8cb93.jpg[/img]
The item interactables include candles to light with a match or with the fire pit. Place these candles anywhere in the world, hold them, let them light each other or arrange them in patterns. Spawn the backpack in to carry some or duplicate any items as well. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/b3e7faeea498f31bd21e0a1039a0174dc0b4fc88.jpg[/img]
There is no limits to how much you can spawn in except your computer. I’ve tested spawning in dozens of rocks and candles and pushed it to the limit. There is a delete button to clear them out if your system gets bogged down, but I wanted to give you as much freedom as possible. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/ed1f368583307181bd27784a78870c840a628944.jpg[/img]
[b]Level System and Titles[/b]
Earn XP just by being in the Zen Garden and earn much more when listening to musics, beats, or meditations. Lighting candles also grants XP. Work your way from Beginner to Zen Master! Its a great way to see how far you can progress in your training of the mind.

[b]Sand Garden[/b]
The sand garden got a retouch and looks much better now.

[b]Roadmap 2023[/b]
This is a great time to let us know what you would like to be able to spawn, or an idea for an interactive system.

v1.21 will introduce more interactables and stations. Campfires and Lanterns you can place anywhere is coming, and other think we though about is a simple bowling system (thought it would be fun to bowl off the dock), archery in the forest.

V1.2.2-5 – Placeables - Flowers / Plants that can be placed down and saved so you can have a bit of a customization to the garden. May even go as far to allow you to remove the stock flowers and fully customize the garden if it doesn’t bog down the game.

V1.3 ASMR Playground Update
I am working on a system to spawn a speaker and have it float anywhere you want and you pick a custom ASMR sound loop. Since VR has 3D audio making sounds all around you can be very fun and relaxing. I was remembered by a time playing Zenith we put a bunch of containers that bubbled all around a person and the sound was amazing. 

V1.4 Outer Worlds Update
I am also experimenting with other alternative worlds that can be possible in VR. Like a world just made of bubbles or colors and a world like the white room from the matrix. Removing all visual stimuli to relax the mind in a deep meditation or even trance like meditations.

V1.5 Maybe?
I have been training with Hemi-Sync and The Gateway Process (Little CIA project in the 80s) to induce deep states of relaxation to allow the mind to escape the body, a sort of out of body experience. Some believed to even allow for remote viewing and transcending time and space itself with the mind. I asked ChatGPT the outcome of the over decade study and it seems the scientific community is divided on whether the phenomena is “Real” or just in the mind. In any case it’s interesting to explore and would love to add something similar based on the process.

notes.title: VR Zen Garden 1.1 Free Binaural Beats DLC!
notes.content:
[b]Binaural Beats[/b]

This DLC brings over 5 hours of Binaural beat music to VR Zen Garden! 

When you hear two tones in each ear that are slightly different in frequency, your brain processes a beat at the difference of the frequency. This is called a binaural beat. Your brain gradually falls into synchrony with the difference. 

Delta: 1-4 Hz - Deep sleep, Healing and pain relief, Anti-aging: cortisol reduction/DHEA increase, Access to the unconscious mind

Theta: 4-8 Hz - Deep relaxation, reduced anxiety, Creativity

Alpha: 8-14 Hz - Relax and focus, Reduce Stress, Maintain positive thinking, Increase your learning capabilities

Beta: 14-30 Hz - Keeping your attention focused, Analytical thinking and solving problems, Stimulating energy and action, High-level cognition

Gamma: 30-100 Hz - Increased cognitive enhancement, Attention to detail, helping in memory recall, A different way of thinking, which is a sign of creativity.

notes.title: VR Zen Garden 1.0 Prerelease!
notes.content:
We are close to getting out of early access into a 1.0 Release for VR Zen Garden. Its been quite a journey from the early days, from upgrading Unity, to switching pipelines, adding new arm menus, plants, trees, weather systems and so much more! Thanks for those who have been with us through the beginning and kept us pushing this application further. 

Leaving early access won't mean we are done, it just means we think we are in a stable full game experience. We actually have a free DLC right around the corner we have been working on alongside this update.

What new in 1.0?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/dc66408bb245a03563012d1a4a7dd75ebd97b8be.jpg[/img]
[b]Graphics Engine[/b]
We have upgraded to the Universal Render Pipeline so we can get higher graphics fidelity as well as better optimization for VR. This meant a massive over hall of all textures, water, trees, and plants. The new tree systems looks so much more alive and vibrant now and we spent a lot of time hand placing them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/b43fb17d9eab9407df70a82ec266ba5a2a67cbc4.jpg[/img]
[b]UI Menus & Player[/b]
We have added options for teleport movement and smooth movement as well as snap/smooth turning.
Added options to pause, resume, and stop audio, and time status.
Added an exit menu
Added menus for future content
Added teleport for the flower bed area
Added 2 new meditation music only tracks, about an hour each
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/2cfab5cce5bb7685387c424d65fb9d07c32d9252.jpg[/img]
[b]Butterfly Tents[/b]
We have a new feature near the Eastern lake, the Butterfly Tent. Complete with a bed to lay down and relax!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/d14c3742038427d534f499e7120da856fd9ff952.jpg[/img]
[b]Optimization[/b]
We spend even more time optimizing and got this to run at about 70fps on a OLD GTX-1050! We definitely recommend having more power for VR, but this was a great success for such a detailed world. And it gives us headroom to add more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/5419cc7b30e6164adcda0f0566458ef96148442f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/0a00b79caaa6388f6b2cdc70030c10fe9e201708.jpg[/img]

notes.title: V0.90 UPDATE NEW VR-Player system, Arm Menu, Teleports, Dynamic lights / Shadows
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/187db3205ccc99dae75eaefeae46317d4c5508e7.png[/img][b]Unity 2021[/b]
Reconstructed with the latest stable Unity3d version and the latest version of Envrio (clouds, weather, seasons, day/night cycle) Upgraded to OpenVR / OpenXR capability. 

[b] VR-Player System[/b]
New VR player interaction system with remote grabbing abilities, teleport and smooth locomotion options, and the ability to add much more. This also meant we had to rework all objects and menu systems.

[b]Arm Menu System[/b]
Now you can change your meditations anywhere in the world. We also included a new Teleport menu to teleport to your favorite spots! 

[b]Lighting / Optimizations[/b]
With the new Enviro we have tweaked all the lighting, day / night cycles and dynamic shadows as the sun and moon move throughout the day. We added a ton of optimizations and tweaks to make it look good and run well on mid range systems. This is a pretty detailed world with a lot of moving trees, grasses, leaves, birds, butterflies, etc. So we do recommend a GTX 3070 or higher. Its not a game meant to be zooming around and running.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/74090f5273e8285a7e8b812e34b688c3c677e235.png[/img]
[b]Seasons / Weather[/b]
We added Summer with the seasons menu which adds chances of rain. You start off in the Spring which will has no rain. And winter works like before, it will change the landscape to a winter wonderland and add chances of snow. The nights are a bit darker and feel right with the nice big moon. 

[b]Shed[/b]
We left a little Easter-egg in the shed to experience the world a different way. :) We used it for debugging, but thought it might be nice to allow the player to reach new heights. 

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
0.90 Unity 2021, VRIF System, teleport, arm menu, dynamic lighting and shadows, optimizations.
0.80 Major optimizing changes for textures.
0.79 Fix some texture bugs.
0.78 4 Day seasons and quick change between winter and spring, starts in summer. 
0.77 Added 3 more type of partly cloudy stages and rain.
0.76 Added support for Season changes
0.75 Optimizing and Winter Wonderland Update
0.74 Added snow terrain.
0.73 Snow effects added and weather starts with snowing.
0.71 Organized panels, added music sections with 3 titles, 2 new.
Thanks for letting us journey together!

notes.title: Version 0.80 More optimization and full season support
notes.content:
[b]Optimizations[/b]
We revamped some more graphics changes with still keeping the looks and feel we want of being surrounded in a garden and forest. It looks like we got at least 50% more performance so it should be a little smoother. In most of the experience though users are encouraged to find a spot they like and relax and listen, not run around, so framerate is not a big issue even for older cards. 

[b]Seasons[/b]
The seasons are setup fully now. You start in Summer which has more chances of rain, which is a new weather type we added. Spring and fall have a little less chance, and none in the winter. Winter is a high chance of snow and if you use the button to switch the seasons it will also change the terrain like in 0.75.
There is 4 days to each season so you will see the sun, moon, stars change a bit faster now too. We also added a few more variants of partly cloudy to mix it up.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.70 Update - Words for encouragement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/bec7ea9c648cf7ed4e60589172eb33712a80862d.png[/img]
This was going to be two patches, but we decided to roll them into one big patch with over 50 quotes from Buddha and the Bible.

[b]Wise Rock[/b]
We added a rock in the left garden which contains many helpful verses from the Bible. Much of this wisdom will help you in struggles with stress, anxiety, fear, worry, anger, negativity and more. It's very important to get our minds right if we are to heal properly. They are displayed randomly each session and include buttons to press if you want more random verses. 

[b]Buddha Quotes[/b]
Buddha was a wise teacher and much of his teachings were very similar to Jesus. Love others as you love yourself, get rid of anger and resentment, willingness to give, etc. We added a wood tablet with quotes and a button to get more random quotes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/6f8d7d9040358658d27b17fc226076582cc4fe57.png[/img]

I feel when we live by these standards and teachings, not by religion, not by persecution, not from a feeling of list of rules put on us, but from a heart of love to a God who loves us, we become better people and it makes a profound change in our lives and the lives of everyone we encounter. 

Thanks for letting us journey together!

notes.title: Version 0.65 Update - ASMR / Sprinklers / New Meditation!
notes.content:
This is a big update packed with same great new goodies!

[b]New Meditation[/b]
We recreated the garden meditation and this brand new version is voiced by our female talent. We wanted to have as much variety to choose from in our meditation library. We believe this one will be a great new addition!

[b]ASMR Table[/b]
Autonomous sensory meridian response (ASMR), sometimes auto sensory meridian response, is a tingling sensation that typically begins on the scalp and moves down the back of the neck and upper spine. 

ASMR signifies the subjective experience of "low-grade euphoria" characterized by "a combination of positive feelings and a distinct static-like tingling sensation on the skin". It is most commonly triggered by specific auditory or visual stimuli, and less commonly by intentional attention control. A genre of videos which intend to stimulate ASMR has emerged, of which over 13 million are published on YouTube.
-- Wikipedia 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/2387e6683be0429693ef12cc6b0fbf855fe68522.png[/img]
The ASMR table can be found in the left garden near the pond. It features a wand that lets you play various different sounds like hair brushing, plastic crinkling, paper sounds, water sounds and more! Most will play for 20-30 seconds and you can restarted them anytime you like. You can combine these with meditation or the music or just with the world itself. 

[b]Sprinklers[/b]
In the left garden as well, you will find a new sprinkler system you can turn on to listen and watch the flowers get watered as you enjoy one of the meditations. The gentle sounds of water can be very relaxing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/7ce5b5181ef3451d0df88906b47c8790fb0c454f.png[/img]

Thanks for letting us journey together!

notes.title: Version 0.62 Update - Interactive Sounds - Tibetan Bowls
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/d16dfe515c68c96e6c61249a9411f93bb9329039.png[/img]

[b]Tibetan Singing Bowls[/b]
Even though meditation is suppose to be a still and calming experience we wanted to add a little more interactivity to the world. These bowls are great combined with just the music or even by themselves. It can be very relaxing to find the frequencies that relaxing you the most or even combine 2 different bowls to find the sounds you like best. All of them are about 25-30 sec long and will restart if hit again. Just grab the wood rod and bang away!

Side note: Due to the physics of VR we made the rod not collide with the bowls when struck because we didn't want bowls flying all over the ground so the rod will go through them when struck.

We added a few more trees to the Asian inspired area. And added a decorative swing to the pond/dock area.

notes.title: Version 0.61 Update - Trees, Foliage & New Meditation!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/4bc2fc8e7d54f119d5920e20851ce3ad4cc5b783.png[/img]

[b]Trees[/b]
We spent a lot of time adding dozens of trees to the forest and the mountains so the garden has a nice background view now. We also updated a lot of trees in the Eastern Area and have more planned for that area as well. 

[b]Grasses[/b]
The left garden got a bit of an upgrade with new grasses and birch trees. We are experimenting with different grasses to find the look and feel that we want.

[b]Optimizations[/b]
We are keeping a close eye on frame-rates on the GTX 970 and trying to keep a careful balance of beauty and frame-rate. It isn't suppose to be a fast action game, but we still want it playable on lower end systems. Supporting a 5-6 year old graphics card seems to be a reasonable starting point. This will be ongoing as the project grows.

[b]Bugs[/b]
We got rid of several more unseen errors and bugs we had along the way. 

[b]Meditations[/b]
We added a great grounding counting meditation! Its super simple to learn and great for people who get distracted easily. A grounding meditation helps your mind focus on physical and calms a racing or distracted mind. It about 9 min, but you can do it anywhere from 5-20 minutes. 

Thanks for letting us journey together!

notes.title: Version 0.60 Update - Big changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/4ca19f572ff1ea2d14967351a35dfdefd24dd4e8.png[/img]

[b]Sound Effect Updates[/b]
We made several big changes in this update and been working on this for the past 2 weeks (before launch in early-access).  Originally we did the sound effects like wind and birds in the meditation, but we decided it needed to be in the world instead. Especially because we plan to have more than one meditation now and the project has been growing so much beyond what we originally planned. So we took the effects out and added them to the day / night cycle so you hear birds in the day and crickets at night. We are trying to make it in the background as much as possible so it's not a distraction and very subtle. 

[b]Time of day UI update[/b]
A lot of our beta testers also requested to have the ability to pick the time and day and have it lock or resume. So we added buttons for morning, afternoon, evening, and the middle of the night. It also has a working clock that runs so if you have a favorite hour, you can find it and lock it. We felt this was important because the sky and colors really set the mood of the landscape and some of the changes are very beautiful. 

[b]Logic behind our UI Panel[/b]
Some of our beta testers requested we had a popup VR panel or watch panel but we felt from the beginning we didn't want to break the immersion of being in this world. We didn't want you to feel like you were in just another VR simulation, but you are in and part of this world and you need to go somewhere to press the buttons.

[b]Misc[/b]
We added a music only play option for those that want an unguided meditation, it still says coming soon as I don't know how it will perform on everyone's system, as it a big audio file. But do check it out!

We also fixed a lot of misc meshes that didn't have colliders or broken ones.

[b]Possible Upcoming[/b]
We have a lot of planned upcoming in no particular order and not set it stone:
1. More meditations - is a must add
2. The sand in the Japanese area to look better and maybe more decor
2. New varieties or more dense trees for the back and right gardens. Left garden is pretty dense, we like how that turned out.
3. Bird AI needs work
4. Maybe a few more butterfly areas
5. Fish or other wildlife like rabbits ?
6. More tweaks or even redo of the ambient effects

If you want the update as soon as possible, you can restart steam, otherwise it can take 24 hours for steam to push it out. It can also take a bit for all steam servers so update around the world.

notes.title: Version 0.52 Update - UI panel revamp
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38028166/f6073e95d95d8a4b7caa5f9f64740330d9f543ce.jpg[/img]
Its nice to take a break from all the marketing, art, store page design etc and get back into working on the project again. I wasn't 100% happy with the old UI panel because sometimes the hand would click the button below and not the one your hovering over, so I redid the layout and added smaller buttons instead of the entire text. It works great now with a light tap with your finger it presses in and starts the audio. I also added space for future items that are planned.

notes.title: Live on Steam & Beta Testing!
notes.content: We are excited to announce our Steam page going live and we are in the final stages of being publicly available. We are hosting a closed beta test for a few weeks to make sure controls work on all headsets and if everything goes well we hope to release into Early Access by the end of the month!
